Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

as preposition

in the role of, being

also as a boy, as a child, as an old man, as consul, when I was a boy, in the role of

classical

Cic. Sen. 10: senem adulēscēns ita dīlēxī
Cic. Sen. 26: litterās Graecās senex didicī

nōmen in eōdem cāsū

construction: no word for “as”; the noun agrees with the person in case

as (a boy, an old man): the noun beside its subject, in the same case

“I learned Greek as an old man” is litterās Graecās senex didicī. “When I was a boy” can also be the ablative absolute mē puerō.

Other words

  • prō + abl. — as, for (held as, serving as)

    preposition with the ablative · also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 87.3: prō pulmentāriō sunt … prō pāne; Ter. Ad. 48: amāvī prō meō

    What a person or thing is taken for or serves as; and in titles of office held in another’s place: prō cōnsule, as proconsul. For “in place of”, locō with the genitive (see instead).

Examples

  • ego Q. Maximum, eum quī Tarentum recēpit, senem adulēscēns ita dīlēxī, ut aequālem

    Quintus Maximus, the man who recovered Tarentum, I loved as a young man, old as he was, as if he were my own ageCic. Sen. 10

  • et ego fēcī quī litterās Graecās senex didicī

    and so did I, who learned Greek as an old manCic. Sen. 26

  • ēditus in lūcem jacuit sine vīribus īnfāns; mox quadrupēs rītūque tulit sua membra ferārum

    brought into the light, he lay there as a baby without strength; soon he moved his limbs on all fours, the way animals doOv. Met. 15.221–222

  • mē puerō, ut meminī

    when I was a boy, as I rememberPrud. Apoth. 450

  • nusquam sine cāricīs, numquam sine pugillāribus; illae, sī pānem habeō, prō pulmentāriō sunt, sī nōn habeō, prō pāne

    never anywhere without dried figs, never without my notebooks: the figs serve as a relish if I have bread, and as bread if I have noneSen. Ep. 87.3

  • cum prō cōnsule in Ciliciam proficīscēns vēnissem Athēnās

    when I had come to Athens on my way to Cilicia as proconsulCic. de Or. 1.82

See also instead, like, represent.
